name: Amanda DuBois
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: As the founder of an all-women boutique family law firm, DuBois Levias Law Group, I help clients discover that ending a marriage can create a unique opportunity for a new beginning. My firm provides those seeking legal advocacy with emotional support and education to empower themselves during and after the divorce. I am also the author of the Camille Delaney mystery series, where I combine my experience as a nurse-turned-attorney to shed light on the justice system through powerful storytelling. My passion for justice led me to found the Civil Survival Project, an organization that teaches advocacy skills to formerly incarcerated people. I also serve on the board of Freedom Education Project Puget Sound, which provides post-secondary education to women inside Washington’s women’s prison. I recently created, and funded, The Full Circle Scholarship at my alma mater, Seattle University School of Law to provide tuition support for students who have been impacted by the criminal legal system.
honors: Recipient of the Sally P. Savage Leadership in Philanthropy Award , Washington State Bar Association , 2022
